title: MU-Bench: A Multitask Multimodal Benchmark for Machine Unlearning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot transfer performance of original and unlearned models on adversarial or out-of-distribution shifted test sets (e.g., CIFAR100-C for CIFAR100, Rotten Tomatoes for IMDB, UCF101-DS for UCF101) to measure whether machine unlearning methods amplify or restrict a model's dependence on shortcut features and inherent dataset biases.
